name: pocket-code-editor
description: A code editor app for Android (Capacitor + plain HTML/CSS/JS)

scripts.build:www: rm -rf www && mkdir www && cp index.html style.css highlight.js app.js sw.js manifest.webmanifest icon-192.png icon-512.png www/
scripts.android:add: npm run build:www && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
